claims.claim: You can apply or do this online.
claims.quote: You can report changes using your business rates valuation account .
claims.note: The page allows online valuation changes, but does not say general business rates registration can be done online.

claims.claim: You can apply or do this by phone.
claims.quote: Call the Valuation Office if you need help with: Council Tax business rates self-catering holiday lets
claims.note: The phone number is for help with business rates, not an explicit registration route.
The text does not specify a business address as application evidence.

claims.claim: The date of occupation is required.
claims.note: The text does not specify a date of occupation as application evidence.

claims.claim: The nature of the business is required.
claims.quote: the nature of your business changes
claims.note: The page says a change in the nature of business can affect rates, but does not say it must be supplied for registration.
